article.title: При + preposicional: introducción
article.chapter: Preposicional y segundo locativo — Предложный падеж и второй предложный

claims.summary: Timberlake classifies при among prepositions that govern the locative/prepositional case.
Timberlake gives exact spatial and temporal-modal examples при станции, при Екатерине and при погрузке.
The passage distinguishes domains and meanings, supporting context-dependent translation rather than a single fixed gloss.
